name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light mode toggle** in the top-right.

Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light and improve focus by reducing glare, aligning with our goal of clarity and liveliness. A persistent toggle ensures users aren’t forced into a mode they dislike, trading a small cognitive load for universal comfort. This matches Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark interface, reinforcing consistency without sacrificing user control.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Defaulting to dark mode ignores users who work in bright environments or need high contrast for visibility—glare-sensitive users still lose. A **system-wide light theme by default with a persistent dark mode toggle** covers both cases; settle this with user testing in both lighting conditions.
